description: July was the tightest month of the sample: the available places were exhausted early in the month, so a case that month was almost always held back whatever its vulnerability score. The origin country is not in an active conflict area and no security incident was recorded. The appointment was held without an interpreter, so part of the account was second-hand and the file was closed on the form values alone. The month was therefore doubly hostile to this household, on budget and on interpretation.
